title: REPRO: Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimizer for Automated LLM Red-Teaming
abstract: arXiv:2610.15513v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to adversarial prompts that bypass their safety training. Existing automated red-teaming methods either require privileged access unavailable in production, rely on manually engineered per-model templates, or optimize a single objective without population-level diversity. We present REPRO (Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimization), a pure black-box framework that discovers adversarial prompts through evolutionary optimization driven entirely by a compressed open-weight 7B reflective model on a single consumer GPU. REPRO introduces two mechanisms absent from prior work, both isolated in a component ablation: semantic crossover, an LLM-guided multi-parent recombination operator, and Bayesian strategy selection via Thompson Sampling informed by structured failure analysis.   We catalog REPRO's behavior on AdvBench, JailbreakBench, and HarmBench across 36 target models from 1

translated_title: REPRO：面向自动化大语言模型红队测试的反思式进化提示优化器
translated_abstract: 经过安全对齐的大语言模型（LLM）仍然容易受到绕过其安全训练的对抗性提示的攻击。现有的自动化红队测试方法要么需要生产环境中无法获得的特权访问权限，要么依赖于为每个模型手动设计的模板，要么仅优化单一目标而缺乏种群层面的多样性。我们提出了REPRO（反思式进化提示优化），这是一个纯黑盒框架，完全由一个压缩的开源7B反思模型在单张消费级GPU上驱动，通过进化优化来发现对抗性提示。REPRO引入了以往工作中不存在的两种机制，并在组件消融实验中分别得到验证：语义交叉（一种由LLM引导的多亲本重组算子），以及基于结构化失败分析、通过汤普森采样实现的贝叶斯策略选择。我们在AdvBench、JailbreakBench和HarmBench上，针对来自多个系列的36个目标模型系统地记录了REPRO的行为表现。
tldr: REPRO是一个纯黑盒的反思式进化提示优化框架，仅依靠单张消费级GPU上运行的7B开源反思模型，通过语义交叉算子和基于汤普森采样的贝叶斯策略选择，自动发现能够绕过大语言模型安全对齐的对抗性提示。
en_tdlr: REPRO is a pure black-box reflective evolutionary prompt optimizer that discovers adversarial prompts bypassing LLM safety alignment using only a compressed 7B open-weight reflective model on a single consumer GPU, introducing novel semantic crossover and Thompson Sampling-based Bayesian strategy selection mechanisms.
